QUOTE: | C → caller, `char*` return | Caller owns it; free with `entropic_free()` | `entropic.h` ~L33, L227–249 | ... | C → caller, `const char*` | Owned by the handle; valid until the next call on that handle. Don't free. | `entropic.h` L36 |
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a returned `char*` is caller-owned and freed with `entropic_free`, and that a `const char*` is handle-owned and valid only until the next call on that handle.
